notes.title: Patch notes V1.0.2:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Ouroboros ring buff: now will not grant random buffs and will instead give 15HP, 2 Speed, 2 Attack and 2 max hits buffs to your leader for each ring.
[*] Relic limit increased, ouroboros rings will now appear later (or with a small chance) since this limit was increased.
[*] Battle speed now stays the same between battles.
[*] New bosses for level 100 for the Demo.
[*] Simplified Chinese translations.
[/list]
[b]Only on the full game:[/b]
[list]
[*] New unlockable relic that will buff your troops based on the amount of ouroboros rind you have.
[*] New Glitch Cultist boss found on level 33.
[*] New Glitch Lich Lord found on floor 66.
[/list]

notes.title: Epic Pixel War Release
notes.content:
Epic Pixel War is now released with all the playable bosses, obtainable units, new relics, achievements and some secrets.

Unlock all the playable units and bosses to build the strongest army to face challenging armies in hard mode.

Thank you to everyone who has played and tested the game until now, I will continue to improve the game on any feedback I receive.  

If you have any questions or bugs to report, you can let me know through the discord or a community post.

Hope everyone enjoys the full version of the game!

notes.title: Hunt for the corrupted units
notes.content:
The latest update to the demo adds three rare corrupted units that can be found after level 15. 

They are a bit hard to find and a lot stronger than regular ones, for anyone willing to take up the challenge, the first ones to submit a screenshot of one of these unit being found in the [url=https://discord.gg/7yZ56XYvz3]discord[/url] get a free key of the game on launch.

There are three keys that will be given away, one for each of the corrupted units.

Will you take up the challenge and be the first to find one them?  

[i]Here is sneakpeak of what they look like, make sure you don't miss them[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969066/91ef494c7f7dc02c01f1acf70ce368241d07e124.gif[/img]

You can share the screenshot of you finding them in the map menu or while fighting them and if you defeat it, you will earn a bonus reward.
